name: SohoPay Agent Skills
description: Skill index for AI agents integrating with the SohoPay MCP gateway, merchant-as-settler x402, and credit settlement.

skills.name: setup
skills.title: SohoPay Agent Setup for AI Agents
skills.description: Detect this harness, optionally install sticky SohoPay skills, and connect hosted MCP. Use when the operator asks to set up SohoPay, bootstrap agents.sohopay, or Set up https://sohopay.xyz/install — not for staging-only E2E, spending, or HTTP 402.

skills.name: setup-staging
skills.title: SohoPay Agent Setup (Staging)
skills.description: Pin staging.api / staging.mcp and chain to canonical setup. Use when the operator asks for staging SohoPay setup or Set up https://staging.sohopay.xyz/install — not for production.

skills.name: mcp-connect
skills.title: Connect to SohoPay MCP Server
skills.description: Register hosted SohoPay MCP and complete OAuth. Use when connecting MCP, OAuth, or tools/list after setup — not for onboarding or payments.

skills.name: mcp-connect-staging
skills.title: Connect to SohoPay MCP Server (Staging)
skills.description: Register sohopay-staging at staging.mcp.sohopay.xyz/mcp. Use when connecting staging MCP — not production.

skills.name: borrower-onboard
skills.title: SohoPay Borrower Onboarding
skills.description: Make this host spend-ready: register the terminal, wallet proof, scoped token, Protocol V2 workload key, and an ACTIVE agent grant. Use when whoami shows no borrower, wallet_proof is missing, dropped_scopes, X402_AGENT_KEY_NOT_REGISTERED, or the operator asks to onboard — not for a warm 402 pay or delegated sessions.

skills.name: human-direct-flow
skills.title: SohoPay Human-Direct Flow
skills.description: Run the default human-direct operate path (whoami through prepare_x402_payment and settlement_id polling). Use when the borrower acts directly, SESSION_GATE_SKIPPED_NO_SESSION appears, or after MCP connect to operate — not for create_agent_session.

skills.name: spend-and-pay
skills.title: SohoPay Spend, Policy, and Signing
skills.description: Create spend intents, evaluate policy, and sign PaymentIntents (policy_decision_id, intentSig). Use when creating spend, evaluate_spend_policy, sign_transaction, RISK_FIRST_TIME_MERCHANT, or polling settlement_id — not for assembling X-PAYMENT or VOUCHER_ISSUED.

skills.name: x402-credit-pay
skills.title: SohoPay x402 Credit Settlement
skills.description: Pay HTTP 402 merchants with prepare_x402_payment, VOUCHER_ISSUED, and merchant-as-settler PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. Use when a URL returns 402, X-PAYMENT, facilitator settle, or borrower-direct /api/v2/x402 — never execute_payment or create_agent_session on human-direct.

skills.name: authorize-agent
skills.title: SohoPay Authorize Agent (Borrower Grant)
skills.description: Obtain an ACTIVE AgentAuthorizationGrant via authorize_agent (consent page + borrower EIP-712). Use when onboarding just registered the workload key, or prepare_x402_payment returns AGENT_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED — not for wallet-proof or voucher Ed25519 signing.

skills.name: idempotency
skills.title: SohoPay Idempotency
skills.description: Pass idempotency_key (UUID v4) on SohoPay write tools. Use when Cursor or ChatGPT cannot set Idempotency-Key, or a write is retried — not for whoami.

skills.name: agent-session
skills.title: SohoPay Agent Sessions (Delegated)
skills.description: Create a delegated SohoPay agent session. Use when the operator asks for create_agent_session — not human-direct and not an HTTP 402 pay.
